about_short_description.short_description: Spire Law provides and offers lawyers and legal services to employees and businesses.

product.name: Business Litigation Defense
product.description: Legal defense services for businesses and business owners in federal and state litigation involving various business disputes.

product.name: Labor and Employment Law Services
product.description: Legal services addressing labor and employment issues including FLSA, ADA, Title VII, retaliation, FMLA, and EEOC charges.

identifier.value: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliance and Defense

product.name: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliance and Defense
product.description: Legal guidance and defense related to ADA requirements, including workplace accommodations and public accommodation compliance.

identifier.value: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Compliance and Litigation

product.name: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Compliance and Litigation
product.description: Legal services to help employers comply with FMLA requirements and defend against related claims of interference or retaliation.

identifier.value: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Litigation and Defense

product.name: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Litigation and Defense
product.description: Legal defense and advisory services for employers regarding wage, overtime, and recordkeeping disputes under the FLSA.

product.name: Discrimination and Harassment Defense
product.description: Legal services to defend employers against workplace discrimination and harassment claims under federal and state laws.
